# PiTTy v0.5.16

PiTTy v0.5.16 preserves prompt drafts queued during compaction and reports subagent activity from substantive tool events.

## Compaction Drafts

- Prompt text submitted while context compaction is running remains in the editor until the queued message is delivered.
- A newer draft typed while the queued message is waiting is preserved instead of being cleared after compaction.

## Subagent Activity

- Subagent last-activity timestamps and transcript refreshes now use substantive tool activity instead of streaming-only updates.
